typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ArchDelDate as timestamp (),
	BatchDate as timestamp (),
	BatchDt as timestamp (),
	BatchId as integer (),
	ForLoop as integer (),
	gv_OracleArch as string (),
	gv_OracleDeleteArch as string (),
	gv_OracleDeleteStage as string (),
	gv_OraclePassword as string (),
	gv_OracleProvider as string (),
	gv_OracleUserID as string (),
	gv_SqlServerProvider as string (),
	gv_strOracleDS as string (),
	OraStageQuery as string (),
	strDataSource as string (),
	strInitialCatalog as string (),
	strPassword as string (),
	strUserName as string (),
	SYIN_INST as decimal(0,0) (),
	VarFileName as string (),
	VarFilePath as string (),
	VarFolderPath as string (),
	VarForLoopCount as integer (),
	VarForLoopQuery as string (),
	Variable as string (),
	Variable1 as integer (),
	VarSYIN_INST as string ()
}

source(output(
		RUN_DATE as timestamp,
		FACETS_ERROR as string,
		RETURN_CODE as string,
		ERROR_CODE as string,
		ID1 as string,
		ERR_MESSAGE as string,
		BATCH_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: 'User::OraStageQuery',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> OraSrc
OraSrc derive({Copy of BATCH_ID} = toInteger(BATCH_ID),
		{Copy of RUN_DATE} = toString(RUN_DATE)) ~> OraDataconversion
OraDataconversion sink(input(
		{Copy of RUN_DATE} as string,
		{Copy of BATCH_ID} as integer,
		RUN_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		BATCH_ID as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	mapColumn(
		{Copy of RUN_DATE},
		{Copy of BATCH_ID},
		RUN_DATE,
		BATCH_ID)) ~> OutputPlaceHolderOraDest
